questions.question: How was Elijah taken up to heaven?
options: In a bright cloud that hid him from view
In a whirlwind, with a chariot of fire
In a blaze of light upon the mountaintop
On the wings of a mighty rushing wind
questions.answer: In a whirlwind, with a chariot of fire

questions.question: What did Elisha ask for from Elijah?
options: A double portion of his spirit
Only his cloak as a keepsake
A great fortune in silver and gold
A simple blessing for his journey
questions.answer: A double portion of his spirit
